scripts.init: docker compose run --rm zephyr west init -l .
scripts.update: docker compose run --rm zephyr west update
scripts.build: docker compose run --rm zephyr west build -b native_sim src/smoke
scripts.test: docker compose run --rm zephyr west build -t run
scripts.clean: docker compose run --rm zephyr rm -rf build
scripts.smoke: npm run init && npm run update && npm run build
